confirmedIssues.title: Nested handler error envelope loses code and message before the page classifier.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: RespondError emits {error:{code,message}}. Direct parseError reads body.code and string body.error only; request then falls through to resilientFetch, which also reads err.code and passes the error object as ApiError message. SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED is therefore absent from final ApiError.code and message can become [object Object]. The page's correctly narrowed unsupported branch cannot recognize this normal handler error. SCHEMA_DRIFT_FAILED messages are lost by the same mechanism.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only reproducible case for future isolated test: make the existing request transport receive 503 JSON {error:{code:'SUBSYSTEM_NOT_CONFIGURED',message:'schema_drift subsystem not configured on this deployment'}} on each attempt with no cached payload. Inspect rejected ApiError.code and feed that actual rejection through useSchemaDrift/page. Expected unsupported notice; current source gives generic recoverable failure. No request or test executed here.
confirmedIssues.fix: One narrow shared error-normalization correction covering direct and resilient paths, preserving existing flat envelopes, cancellation, retries and status classification; add isolated transport-to-page regression rather than weaken page code checks.
confirmedIssues.testEvidenceLimit: SchemaDriftPage.test.tsx:159-183 and 403-413 inject preconstructed ApiError, bypassing the actual nested-wire decode.

confirmedIssues.title: Review details contradicts known drift with an empty Attention verdict.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: SchemaKpis supplies metrics/provenance but no attention or narrative. OperationalBrief defaults attention=[] and renders 'No current attention items.' in the details drawer even when status reads Drift detected and guidance tells the operator to confirm migrations/investigate DDL. Default narrative also omits the page's concrete response and limitations.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only future isolated case: supply a valid drift payload with is_different=true, then open existing Review details. Main summary/guidance report drift; drawer Attention resolves to No current attention items. No render/browser action executed here.
confirmedIssues.fix: Pass existing typed attention/narrative derived from the same schema evidence; retain unknown causes, unscored confidence, all metrics and seed/observation-time limitations. No new shared component.

confirmedIssues.title: Fingerprint copy failures have no user-facing outcome.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: Both callers omit withToast and onCopyError. Primitive defaults withToast=false; clipboard rejection only logs to console and resets copied=false. No localized visible or assistive failure feedback reaches this page.
confirmedIssues.repro: Source-only future isolated case: reject navigator.clipboard.writeText with NotAllowedError for either nonempty synthetic hash. Current catch path does not notify the user or offer manual recovery. No clipboard/browser execution performed.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing clipboard-error feedback capability at the caller, with reachable manual-copy recovery if necessary; preserve exact hash and success live announcement.

confirmedIssues.title: Copy actions inherit a mobile size below the explicit 44px contract.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: No size/class override at either fingerprint caller; CopyButton defaults size=sm, forwarded to Button's h-9. Source has no min-h-11/min-w-11 mobile target treatment here, unlike the fixed header refresh. Existing CSS touch-target utilities are opt-in classes, not global button overrides, and neither is applied in this call chain.
confirmedIssues.repro: Static class-chain proof: SchemaFingerprints CopyButton -> size sm -> Button h-9. Future synthetic native check should measure both Copy buttons below md across required widths and verify nonoverlapping hits. Native rectangles, pixel values and WCAG exceptions were not measured here.
confirmedIssues.fix: Use existing caller classes/sizing to enforce the mobile minimum, preserve compact desktop sizing, and separately verify actual composed geometry.
